name: feature.cad.nodes
description: CAD canvas producer node pack. The `render` node emits a typed `canvas.cad` artifact — a constrained parametric model { name?, units?, solids[] } of primitive solids — that flows through the run-output producer and renders inline in the chat artifact workbench as an orthographic SVG projection. Constrained typed JSON, never executable code; pure transform; replay-safe. ADR 0388 P1 adds mesh interchange: mesh-import (canonical STL bytes -> content-addressed host mesh asset + canvas.cad payload) and mesh-export (model -> STL/GLB capability URL) over ctx.features.cad.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Render CAD model
nodes.description: Emit a `canvas.cad` artifact. Inputs: { model } (or `source` JSON) = { name?, units?, solids: [{ kind, x?, y?, z?, width?, height?, depth?, radius?, length?, color?, label?, rotation?, materialId?, metallic?, roughness? }] }. Every listed field is PRESERVED — this node's normalizer used to drop rotation/metallic/roughness silently. kind ∈ box|cylinder|sphere|cone|mesh (mesh carries assetRef -> a stored mesh asset + optional scale). Output: a typed canvas.cad artifact. Pure transform.

nodes.label: CAD Mesh Import
nodes.description: Store canonical binary-STL mesh bytes (contentBase64; sourceFormat stl|obj|gltf; name?; dropped?[]) as a content-addressed, tenant-scoped mesh asset over ctx.features.cad. Outputs { mesh, payload, artifact } — the payload holds one `mesh` solid referencing the asset. Same bytes -> same meshId (replay/fork-safe). Typed failure on malformed/oversized meshes.

nodes.label: CAD Mesh Export
nodes.description: Export a canvas.cad model ({ model, format: stl|gltf }) to interchange bytes via the deterministic tessellator; outputs { url (short-TTL capability), filename, sizeBytes, triangleCount }. Typed failure on empty/invalid models.

nodes.label: CAD BOM Generate
nodes.description: Deterministically project a canvas.cad model ({ model }) into a canvas.cad.bom bill of materials (identical parts rolled up; exact parametric volume/area; mesh volume flagged approximate) over ctx.features.cad. Outputs { bom, csv, artifact }. Computed, never model-authored; typed failure on unknown kinds.

nodes.label: CAD Dimension Suggest
nodes.description: Deterministically propose annotated dimensions for un-dimensioned solids of a canvas.cad model ({ model }) over ctx.features.cad — per kind, the primary defining dimensions (values are always DERIVED from geometry at read time, never stored). Outputs { dimensions }. The agent applies them via render; proposals are closed-world validated on save.

nodes.label: CAD Sketch Solve
nodes.description: Run the DETERMINISTIC 2D sketch constraint solver ({ sketch: { points, segments, constraints } }) over ctx.features.cad — fixed iteration order/tolerance, no clock/RNG, so a replayed run reproduces byte-identical coordinates. Outputs { points, iterations, residual, diagnostics (well/under/over-constrained, freeDof, conflicting) }. Non-convergence and invalid refs are typed failures.

nodes.label: CAD Material Recommend
nodes.description: Deterministically suggest a LIBRARY material per solid of a canvas.cad model ({ model }) from fixed label/kind rules over ctx.features.cad. Outputs { suggestions: [{solid, materialId, current}], library }. Assignment is closed-world by materialId — never free material JSON.
